content.title: New Crypto Deals Put Retail at Risk After $17 Billion Wipeout
content.summary: Instead of raising cash to buy tokens in the open market, DAT sponsors contribute large slugs of their own crypto, often unlisted and hard to value.  Sponsors provide tokens or raise money to buy them, and the stock then trades as a kind of listed bet on crypto.  Earlier deals raised money to buy tokens through regular markets, which offered at least some independent price check.
